0022600110.text: The Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West, 5th in the Northwest and 1.5 games back) host the 0-2 Pelicans (10th in the West, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back) in Denver's second game of the 2026-27 season. Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are out for Denver, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans' Yves Missi (knee) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 road win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
